_help: Optional. Any value here sets the calculator's starting value for everyone who opens the dashboard; delete a line to fall back to the built-in default. team_days_lost = working days the whole team is out (bank holidays, a shutdown, an all-hands). person_days_lost = individual days out, counted per developer (two developers off for three days each is 6). days_lost_notes = shown under the calculator so people can see what the days are. Only count days that fall before development finishes.
